title: Delete a note
user_story: As a caller of the notes API I want to delete a note by id so that a note written by mistake does not stay forever.

acceptance_criteria.text: Deleting an existing note removes it from the store and reports that it was deleted.
Deleting an id that does not exist reports failure and raises nothing.
edge_cases: an id that was never created

acceptance_criteria.text: The API documentation describes deletion alongside create, get and list.
